_comment: Builder-Client MCP set — GitHub + Slack active. Claude Preview (for the visual verification in Builder-Client's CLAUDE.md §5) is DISABLED: its npm package does not exist, so the server has never functioned. Visual verification falls back to Playwright until a real package is confirmed and baked into the router image.

linear._comment: In-process Linear MCP, same router-hosted wrapper Strategist uses (router/src/linear/linearMcp.ts), authed with the session's ${LINEAR_TOKEN} from Infisical LINEAR_TOKEN_builder_client. Replaces the deprecated @modelcontextprotocol/server-linear stdio package, which was left disabled behind an `_` prefix when Strategist migrated — `_`-prefixed servers are skipped by BOTH activeServers() and collectInProcessMcp(), so this agent had no Linear tools at all while its permissions.allow listed five of them, and the decomposition rule in CLAUDE.md told it to call create_issue. No gated_mutations: the ALWAYS-ALLOWED tier (create_issue / create_comment / get_issue / list_issues / search_issues / list_teams / list_labels) is what this agent's allow-list declares; move/assign/close stay out of reach entirely.

github._comment: GitHub MCP — open PRs in the target project repo + the <target-project>-marketing repo (when writing screenshots per Protocol #4). The marketing-repo write scope is per the Product Screenshot Protocol — Builder-Client is the ONLY agent (besides Marketer) with marketing-repo write access.

github_gitdata._comment: In-process Git Data tools (mcp__github_gitdata__move_file / delete_file / apply_file_ops) — content-free rename/delete via blob SHA, for files past the ~40KB Contents-API wall. Lets Builder-Client refactor code that moves/removes files. Instantiated by the router adapter with the session's GitHub App installation token; refuses protected branches (main/staging/…). See router/src/github/gitDataMcp.ts.

slack._comment: Slack MCP — post visual-review screenshots to #engineering; respond to design-system pushback in PR-thread crossposts.

_claude-preview._comment: DISABLED (leading underscore) — `@anthropic-ai/mcp-claude-preview` does not exist on the npm registry; `npm view` returns E404. The package name here was never verified (the original note said as much), so this server has never actually started. Disabled so sessions stop spawning a child that cannot succeed: `npx` resolves on PATH, so spawn() reports success and the handle enters the McpBundle, but the fetch then 404s. NOTE: this was NOT the cause of any observed failure — Builder-Client sessions ran fine with it enabled (see issue german969/chatbots#8, sessions 195/196). An earlier version of this comment claimed it wedged every session; that was wrong. Re-enable by removing the underscore ONCE a real package name is confirmed AND it is baked into the router image the way mcp-server-github / mcp-server-slack are — the deploy deliberately avoids npx-at-runtime. Until then visual verification falls back to Playwright, which settings.json already anticipates.

_future_mcp_candidates._comment: Possible additions during Phase 4+ if the project benefits. NOT enabled at v1.
_future_mcp_candidates.storybook: If the project uses Storybook, an MCP for component-isolated visual testing could pair with Claude Preview.
_future_mcp_candidates.figma: Figma MCP — if the project uses Figma for design files, this lets Builder-Client read component specs / design-token definitions directly from Figma. Useful for the claude-design-handoff skill.
_future_mcp_candidates.chromatic: If the project uses Chromatic for visual regression, an MCP could integrate the test runs into pr-feedback responses.
